target.statement: StyleHEAT generates 1024x1024 one-shot talking face video from a single source image driven by a video, achieving higher resolution than prior methods (Table 1 comparison).

compute.basis: Requires training two motion generators (200K iterations each on VoxCeleb) plus joint fine-tuning (20K iterations) on HDTF, all with a frozen StyleGAN2 1024x1024 generator and GAN inversion; no code released, so the entire pipeline must be reimplemented from scratch.

blockers: No code or model weights released
Requires training multiple networks for hundreds of thousands of iterations
Needs large datasets (VoxCeleb ~100K videos, HDTF 362 videos) and StyleGAN2 1024x1024 pretrained model
GPU with substantial VRAM required for StyleGAN2 1024x1024 and training
title: StyleHEAT: One-Shot High-Resolution Editable Talking Face Generation via Pre-trained StyleGAN
